title: Spatial optimisation for resilient electric vehicle charging infrastructure
items.abstract: <jats:p>We develop a spatial optimisation model for charging station planning under grid outages. The model improves charging resilience through redundant siting.</jats:p>

title: Machine learning for urban bus arrival prediction
items.abstract: A machine learning approach predicts bus arrival times.

title: Smart charging for electric vehicle flexibility markets
items.abstract: Smart charging supports electric vehicle flexibility.

title: Forecasting electric vehicle charging demand with deep learning
container-title: Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies
items.abstract: We propose a deep learning method for charging demand prediction. Results show improved short-term forecasts.
